title: Cursor provider fixes, Commits widget, and a dedicated diagram pane key
highlights: The Cursor provider works again: jcode tools run over Cursor's native MCP bridge, fast/high/thinking model ids resolve correctly, /fast works, and reasoning models no longer stop mid-answer
A new Commits info widget shows recent commits with line counts and marks unpushed ones
The swarm dock lists each agent with its status, current activity, and todo progress
improvements: Alt+Shift+M shows or hides the diagram pane, and Alt+M now only cycles the side panel (split, fullscreen, hidden)
Info widgets put their headers, overflow counts, and legends on their borders
The foot terminal is detected as sixel-capable for Mermaid diagrams
The harness API can move a running tool to the background
agentgrep 0.1.7 keeps partial results when ripgrep hits unreadable files
fixes: Anthropic no longer rejects turns with parallel tool_search calls (400 'tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks')
Images no longer render blank in Kitty inside Zellij
Test binaries in custom Cargo target directories never open real browser windows
Several flaky tests are now isolated from the developer's environment
